skill_name: Write a post about why it is important to manage stress
workflow: It is important to manage stress because it can have a significant impact on both physical and mental health. Stress can lead to an increase in blood pressure, disruption of sleep and concentration, digestive problems and even depression. Stress can also lead to unhealthy coping mechanisms such as binge eating, drinking in excess, smoking, and more.
